ruleDefinitions.name: Start Windows Service Via Net.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the usage of the "net.exe" command to start a service using the "start" flag

sequences.query: (((process_path = RGX("\\\\net\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\net1\\\.exe$")) OR (process_original_file_name = "net\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "net1\.exe")) AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ start\\ .*"))
